rationale_md: Brazil enters this Group C encounter as clear favorites with a 140-point Elo rating advantage over Morocco, reflecting their superior talent pool and recent international form. The model assigns Brazil roughly four times the win probability of Morocco, suggesting the Atlas Lions face an uphill battle to secure points against one of the tournament's traditional powerhouses. Morocco will need to replicate their recent tournament resilience and disciplined defensive structure to overcome what appears to be a significant quality gap on paper.
